errors.description: In the non-proof 'falsification attempts' section, the listed initial terms for A=15 are wrong (20 is a term: gcd(20,15)=5, gcd(20,18)=2), and the same paragraph inconsistently invokes 20 as a term. Purely a typo in illustrative commentary; it does not affect the proof.
errors.quote: For \(A=15\), the first terms are \(15,18,22\), while \(21\) is skipped because \(\gcd(21,20)=1\).

parsed.notes: Core chain is sound: unboundedness gives a_{n+1}≤a_n+A; characterization (1) of terms via good prime supports; the key lemma (σ(x)=P(x)∩{p≤A} is good) proved by induction with the R p^k construction (bounds m≥A, m<x correct); periodicity mod L=∏_{p≤A}p on [A,∞) yields a_{n+T}=a_n+L for all n≥1.
